title: On the Difficulty of Sequence-Level Supervised Learning for Autoregressive Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.16736v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: During the supervised learning phase, autoregressive language models are typically trained by minimizing the negative log-likelihood of the training data, which decomposes as a sum of token-level cross-entropies via teacher forcing. This objective is simple and efficient but potentially suffers from so-called exposure bias: a mismatch between the way the model is trained and the way it is used at inference time. Can we instead design sequence-level loss functions that incorporate inference-time decoding procedures, such as greedy decoding or autoregressive sampling? We show that two natural attempts lead to loss functions that are fundamentally flawed: unbounded below. We further show that these two flawed loss functions are intimately connected: using autoregressive Gumbel tricks, the sampling based loss is the expected greedy loss under Gumbel perturbations. Since the pathology stems from the dependence of the decoded sequence on t

translated_title: 论自回归语言模型序列级监督学习的困难性
translated_abstract: 在监督学习阶段，自回归语言模型通常通过最小化训练数据的负对数似然来进行训练，该目标通过教师强制分解为令牌级交叉熵之和。这一目标简单且高效，但可能存在所谓的“曝光偏差”问题：即模型训练方式与推理时的使用方式之间存在不匹配。那么，我们能否设计出将推理时解码过程（如贪婪解码或自回归采样）纳入其中的序列级损失函数呢？我们证明，两种自然的尝试会导致存在根本性缺陷的损失函数：它们是无下界的。我们进一步证明，这两个有缺陷的损失函数之间存在着紧密联系：利用自回归Gumbel技巧，基于采样的损失是Gumbel扰动下贪婪损失的期望值。由于这种病态源于解码后的序列对t（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明了将推理时解码过程纳入训练的两种序列级监督损失函数（基于贪婪解码和自回归采样）都存在无下界的根本性缺陷，并通过自回归Gumbel技巧揭示了二者之间的内在联系。
